title: Sundarkand · Hanuman and Sita
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE new text-free standalone devotional READER ILLUSTRATION for the Vedansh app, a short landscape banner with EXACT 2:1 aspect ratio (e.g. 1920x960). The attached kj-08 and kj-11 images are STYLE references only. Match their soft Indian devotional storybook rendering: fine warm-grey and brown outlines, graceful expressive almond-shaped eyes, broad smooth pastel colour fills, gentle restrained shading, subtle paper grain. Use muted low-saturation warm ivory parchment, powder-blue divine skin, dusty saffron/terracotta, sage, slate blue-grey and restrained matte gold. Simplify background details and ornament while keeping clear poses and meaningful actions. Dignified subjects suitable for the whole app; not chibi or caricature. Create a NEW horizontal composition, do not crop or stretch any portrait or reference. Scale complete subjects to fit; arrange the scene sideways. Keep all crowns, faces, arms, hands, feet, vahanas and meaningful props fully inside a comfortable 7 percent safe margin. Every limb must be connected and the specified arm/character counts exact. Allow only a subtle narrow parchment edge fade; do not copy the portrait references' large empty lower caption band. No tall blank area, UI, text, lettering including Om, captions, labels, watermark, border, photorealism, 3D, dense jewellery, theatrical glow, saturated cobalt, vivid orange or heavy black outlines. Do not copy the references' river/cottage/people onto unrelated scenes. Scene: Hanuman kneels respectfully with joined hands before Sita seated beneath a spreading Ashoka tree. Sita wears a modest traditional sari; Hanuman has a clearly recognizable monkey face and curved tail. Show both entire figures, all hands, feet, Hanuman's complete tail, Sita's seat and the full meaningful action. A peaceful garden fills the wide horizontal backdrop. No Rama and no other figures, no weapons or battle.
